extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the question: (1) The 'species' column had 12 label variants (e.g., 'aDELIE', 'Adeliie', 'Genoto') that were misspellings or case/spaces variants of the allowed labels; these were merged into 'Adelie', 'Chinstrap', and 'Gentoo' using normalize_labels. (2) The 'island' column had 11 label variants (e.g., '  Biscoe ', 'Bicoe', 'Draem') that were misspellings or case/spaces variants of the allowed labels; these were merged into 'Biscoe', 'Dream', and 'Torgersen' using normalize_labels. (3) The 'sex' column had 9 label variants (e.g., 'FEMALE', 'fmale', 'mlae') that were merged into 'male' and 'female'. (4) There were 3 exact duplicate rows that were removed. After these fixes, the analysis showed that 53 Adelie penguins and 147 Gentoo penguins were measured on Biscoe island.
